item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.19
item.description: QA reviews group narration, screenshots, and selected text by finding. Browse compact screenshot previews, open original evidence, and correct passages in the shared transcript reader. Your configured AI can summarize QA narration. Local previews work with AI off. The QA panel stays on screen when adding screenshots or switching findings. Cancel an active or paused meeting or QA review and recover its saved audio and evidence from Trash.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.20
item.description: - Read saved meeting transcripts and recaps, QA findings, and QA screenshots through local MCP. Enable recording access in General settings. - Start QA Review after microphone audio is ready. Keep accepted audio when startup fails, and finish recovery before quitting. - Use narrower dictation and selection overlays with single-line status messages and clear recovery actions.
